name: Revolved Side Angle Pose
description: Lunging twist with the opposite elbow hooked outside the front knee.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Step one foot back into a long lunge, back heel lifted, front knee over the ankle.
Bring your palms together at your chest.

keyframes.name: Mountain Pose
keyframes.cue: Stand tall with your feet together and arms by your sides.

keyframes.name: Revolved Side Angle
keyframes.cue: Lunge on the right leg, hook the left elbow outside the knee, and twist.

cues: Keep the front knee over the ankle.
